description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveAttributes class, which is an immutable command class used to retrieve all attributes of a specific Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization/deserialization of command data.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributes
classes.description: An immutable command class for retrieving all attributes of a specific Thing, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributes.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a RetrieveAttributes instance using ThingId and headers.

methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing the content to extract necessary fields.

methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the selected fields if any were specified.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributes.getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing this command targets.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributes.getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for the attributes (typically '/attributes').

methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.
